selection: Positive non-diagonal published OD demands; demand and directed free-flow shortest-time tertile thresholds; ties remain in lower bin. Within each cell lexicographically sorted OD indices at floor(N/3),floor(2N/3). Empty cells stay empty; cells with only one member contribute one. No attribution values used.
boundary_rule: 36 equally spaced normal directions [0,180), projection midpoints, connected induced sides; OD-oriented regions deduplicated; geometry matches e107.
scope: Endpoint identity supplies total edge attribution; response study/background mechanism is not identified from endpoint flows alone.
